nodes.label: Suiker — patisserie template
nodes.rationale: Maatwerk-tier horeca template (rosy cream, Italiana serif). Archetype I: bento grid — hero and assortment are modular rasters of unequal tiles mixing photo tiles, USP note tiles and an accent stat tile. Cake order form sets a min date of today; live open-status and hours table included.

nodes.label: Bento-grid archetype (modular raster of unequal tiles)
nodes.rationale: Layout mechanism: a 4-column CSS grid with fixed auto-rows where tiles span variable columns/rows (intro 2x2, tall 1x2, wide 2x1, accent 1x1), collapsing to 2 then 1 column on smaller screens. Mixes content types (text intro, product photo, USP note, stat) in one raster instead of separate sections.
